note: CDX for 20250502-20260502 returned no captures (checked twice, HTTP 200, empty, also without the status filter). Both rejected. grayformayor.com was not in the hit list, so I did not check it.

page_evidence: Title: "Re-Elect Sukhee Kang for Mayor of Irvine"; splash page with "paidFor2010.png" banner
note: The 365-day pre-election CDX query (20091103-20101102, HTTP 200 filter) returned no captures for sukheekang.com. Earliest capture is 2010-11-07, five days after the election. The after-window count of 5 covers HTTP 200 captures of all URLs on the domain from 20101103 to 20110302: the root on 20101107, the root and index.htm on 20110128, and two images. The page is a splash page with the title and a paid-for-2010 banner but little text. Kang was the Irvine mayor in 2010, so I judge that it is his 2010 campaign site. mayorkang.com and sukheekangformayor.com had no HTTP 200 captures in the pre-election window (confirmed after retries). Their after-election hits are a 'please come back soon' page and a spam page, and they do not qualify.

note: The only hit is a different person. Joe Moreno ran for mayor of East Moline, IL in 2005. The page is not about Helena Moreno or New Orleans. Rejected as a different person, city and election.

page_evidence: Glen Robertson | A New Direction ... Endorses Glen Robertson for Mayor ... Glen Robertson for Mayor Campaign.
note: CDX for 365 days to 2012-05-12 returned no captures (checked with and without the 200 filter; first capture of the domain is 20120513). The two 200 captures in the after window are 20120513 and 20120614. The robertsonformayor.com hit was only a robots.txt page and was not needed.

page_evidence: Mark McBrayer for Lubbock Mayor ... WHY I AM RUNNING FOR RE-ELECTION AS YOUR MAYOR ... Early Voting: Monday, April 20 - Tuesday, April 28 Election Day: Saturday, May 2
note: Pre-election window (2025-05-03 to 2026-05-02) has 44 HTTP 200 captures, but every page I read shows only 2024 content (June 2024 runoff banner, 2024 Mayor campaign pages, a District 3 page, Wix template filler). None shows the 2026 re-election campaign, so the pre-window pages are from another election. The 2026 re-election content first appears 20260505. The after-window count of 50 is the CDX limit and is a lower bound; a larger limit query returned empty twice.

page_evidence: Stephen Sanders FOR MAYOR About News Events Get Involved ... DONATE SUBSCRIBE ... VOLUNTEER ... Stephen is a proud 41-year-old Lubbock native
note: 25 HTTP 200 captures in the 365 days to 2026-05-02. The 20260215 captures are a JavaScript shell with title 'Stephen Sanders for Mayor of Lubbock 2026 | Lubbock For Everyone' and little text. The Aug 2025 page has no explicit year, but it is a Lubbock mayoral campaign with donate and volunteer calls, and no earlier Sanders mayor race in Lubbock is known.

page_evidence: Bob Cashell for Reno Mayor ... © 2006 BobCashell.com Bob Cashell for Mayor. All rights reserved.
note: Doubt. bobcashell.com is a Cashell mayoral campaign site. It has 1 HTTP 200 capture in the 365 days before the election (20100201143555) and 9 in the after window (first 20101205161636). The pages show a 2006 copyright. They contain no 2010 marker, no vote or donate call and no victory message. The bio says he was elected in 2002 and was Citizen of the Year in 2005. The content looks like it comes from the 2006 election, so I reject it under the other-election rule. bobcashell4mayor.com has no capture before the election. Its only captures are from 2011-02-08 and show the same 92-character template. If Hanno accepts the 2006 template as a standing campaign site, bobcashell.com would be accepted with first capture 20100201143555.

page_evidence: Title: "Janet Cowell for Raleigh Mayor: Leadership, Community, Partnership"; meta description: "Support Janet Cowell for Raleigh Mayor and her priorities for leadership, community, and partnership."
note: The 365-day window (2023-11-06 to 2024-11-05) has 64 HTTP 200 captures across all paths of the domain, so the site existed before the election. The page is a Wix site with little visible text; the evidence comes from the title and meta tags of the capture 4 days before the election. The other hit, cowell4mayor.com, has only a 114-byte stub page (captured 2024-05-18) and a payment subdomain. It was not used.
